The Honed perk can considerably speed up the gathering process for Mining, Woodcutting, and Fishing. 
 Other perks such as Furnace and Imp Souled have no effect on the resources in this encounter.

name: Pontifex shadow ring
desc: The Pontifex shadow ring charged with 1000 resonant anima of Bik reduces the stat drains from Croesus's mechanics by 25% when equipped. After overcharging the ring with 5000 resonant anima of each type, it does not need to be equipped.

name: Skilling familiars
desc: A skilling familiar to boost gathering rates in your primary role: granite lobster for fishing, arctic bear for hunting, gargoyle for mining; and beaver for woodcutting. The summoning level requirements for these familiars are 74, 71, 75, and 33, respectively. (Note: except the gargoyle, all of these familiars will expire in 48 minutes or less upon summoning. For extending familiars, players may bring a second pouch, have a Totem of Summoning active on Anachronia, and/or cast Spiritual Healing.)

name: First Age
desc: Guthix brought humans and other races to Gielinor and created runes. He went to sleep and other gods appeared.

name: Second Age
desc: Zaros arrived to Gielinor and created a large empire. He was overthrown by his general Zamorak, who ascended to godhood.

name: Third Age
desc: Zamorak waged war against the other gods. He tore a continent asunder, resulting in the Wilderness. Guthix woke up and banished the gods.

name: Fourth Age
desc: Orks and goblins destroyed cities, driving humans into nomadism. The humans re-discovered runes and fought back, ultimately establishing dominance over the mainland.

name: Fifth Age
desc: Humans settled and founded kingdoms around the world.

name: Sixth Age
desc: The gods returned to Gielinor and competed for the Stone of Jas. Elder Gods emerged, threatening all life by seeking to remake the universe.

name: Guthix
desc: The god of balance. He created runes and brought humans to Gielinor. In the Third Age, he banished the gods from Gielinor.

name: Saradomin
desc: The god of order. One of the most worshipped gods. His kingdoms Misthalin, Asgarnia and Kandarin cover a large part of the world.

name: Zamorak
desc: The god of chaos. He overthrew his master, Zaros, and waged war against the other gods. At the end of the Third Age, he tore a continent asunder, resulting in the Wilderness.

name: Zaros
desc: An old god who once led one of the largest empires on Gielinor. At the end of the Second Age, he was overthrown by his general Zamorak.

name: Gielinor
desc: The Elder Gods' perfect creation. Once dubbed RuneScape by the first humans on Gielinor due to the caches of runes Guthix had created around the world.

name: Zanaris
desc: Gielinor's moon and home to the hidden kingdom of the fairies.

name: Freneskae
desc: The Elder Gods' birthplace. It was devoured by the Elders and became barren. It is the homeworld of Zaros, Seren and the Mahjarrat.

name: Anima
desc: The living energy of the universe and the source of magic. It is the substance the Elder Gods feed on to nourish their eggs and perpetuate the cycle of the Elder Gods and thus the universe.

name: Necklace of Salamancy
desc: Provides a 15% accuracy and damage buff as well as a 3% drop rarity boost.

name: Salve amulet (e)
desc: Provides a 20% accuracy and damage buff against undead monsters.

name: Bladed dive
desc: Bring a melee weapon switch for a fast method to avoid the AOE damage such as Bladed Dive or Dive.

name: Necrotic runes
desc: Darkness may be used with any style or armour type to reduce damage taken. Additionally, Greater Bone Shield can be used in place of a shield or defender to use defensives without damage loss.

name: Blessed flask
desc: Blessed flask is useful due to the lengthy encounter if you plan on doing all 3 bosses in one go. Alternatively, bring several potions that restore prayer points.

name: Defence reduction
desc: Each boss has very high Defence and moderate affinity, so bringing items such as Invoke Lord of Bones, a guthix staff, black stone arrows can help improve accuracy and damage rates.

name: Consecrated keris
desc: The consecrated keris boosts hit chance by +15% and does 33.3% more damage against all the bosses in the Sanctum of Rebirth. With Hard Desert achievements completed, it boosts hit chance by +25%. Requires completion of Beneath Scabaras' Sands and upgrading the primed keris by killing 200 elite Profane Scabarites.

name: Ode of the Devourer
desc: You need to complete the quest Ode of the Devourer to gain access to this boss.

name: 85+ Mining
desc: It is recommended to have at least level 85+ in Mining to effectively mine cleansed statue shards, which are essential to do damage to the boss.

name: Golem outfits
desc: Use any golem outfit for increased mining critical hit chance.

name: Augmented off-hand
desc: An augmented off-hand with Mobile is helpful to use Surge and Dive twice as often.

name: Augmented shield
desc: An augmented tier 90 shield with Turtling 4 perk is helpful to use Barricade to block damage.

name: Nexus
desc: Lesser Bone Shield or Greater Bone Shield with deathwarden nexus or Zemouregal's nexus, is helpful to use Barricade to block damage.

name: Infernal puzzle box
desc: Infernal Puzzle Box is helpful for adrenaline stalling, to use Barricade to block damage.

name: Honed
desc: The Honed perk on your pickaxe can help speed up the gathering process for mining the southern rocks. Other perks such as Furnace and Imp Souled have no effect on the resources in this encounter.

name: Shadow's Grace
desc: Halves the cooldown of the Surge, Escape, Dive, and Bladed Dive abilities. This allows the player to keep a skilling off-hand worn at all times.

name: Luck of the Dwarves
desc: Simultaneously benefit from tier 4 luck and a ring of whispers.

name: Blessing of Het
desc: Increase the healing of food by 10%, potentially freeing up some inventory spaces for mined cleansed statue shards.

name: Beast of burden or Mining familiar
desc: A Beast of Burden carrying food is useful: Pack mammoth, pack yak, war tortoise. Also useful to store extra cleansed statue shards during mining. Alternatively, players may use a mining boosting familiar such as Lava titan (+10 boost) or Gargoyle (+12 boost).

name: Tagga's corehammer
desc: For mining cleansed shards of Elidinis, the corehammer is helpful but not required to complete this activity.

name: Rock-crushing scrimshaws
desc: Rock-crushing scrimshaw or its superior version created at player-owned ports provides a +3% critical strike chance while mining (+2% with regular scrimshaw).

name: Ring of Whispers
desc: Ring of Whispers grants +3 mining damage.

name: Crystal skillchompa
desc: Crystal skillchompas can be carried in the inventory (but not wielded), to increase mining critical swing damage by 70.

name: Asciatops perk
desc: Asciatops perk at the Anachronia Dinosaur Farm grants +3% or +6% critical swing chance while Mining.

name: Shooting Star buff
desc: This 15-minute buff allows players to potentially get double the cleansed statue shards on every swing, completing the encounter faster. Only works on the south part of the arena.

desc: Bring a melee weapon switch for a fast method to avoid the AOE damage such as Bladed Dive or Dive.

desc: Darkness may be used with any style or armour type to reduce damage taken. Additionally, Greater Bone Shield can be used in place of a shield or defender to use defensives without damage loss.

name: Consecrated keris
desc: Consecrated keris increased the hit chance by 15% and damage by 33.3% against corrupted creatures, soul devourers, Amascut, and her followers. With Hard Desert achievements completed, it boosts hit chance by +25%.

name: Warpbane
desc: Ruinous weapons deal additional damage to this boss.
